parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: **1** to **100**. If you do not specify a value, the default value **20** is used.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
*   You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of **NextToken**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are added to the server group. You can specify up to 10 tags in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alb list-server-group-servers --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXG0000 --max-results 50 --server-group-id sgp-cb25e2i2vr000000 --server-ids i-bp1e0u8f10by57wl0000 --tag Value=Test Key=Test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alb ListServerGroupServers --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key Test --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXG0000 --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value Test --ServerGroupId 'sgp-cb25e2i2vr000000' --ServerIds.1 'i-bp1e0u8f10by57wl0000' --method POST --force
